reason: We have already decided to go into a new country and my network won't reach that far, so I need a pipeline there. The first step costs nothing and I only pay for real meetings, capped at 900, so I'll book the call and if the 15 companies look right I'll start the pilot.
objection: My name is my business. If they send pushy or badly translated emails to buyers I'll want to sell to for years, or we get a GDPR complaint, that costs me more than 900 euros. And every agency on LinkedIn promises meetings, so one logistics case with 45 meetings doesn't prove much for a wholesaler like me.
would_change_my_mind: If the 15 target companies or the first message look generic or wrong for my market, I walk away. A reference I can call from a wholesaler who used them would make me sure.
